verdict.rationale: smolagents lets you push an agent to the Hub as a Space repository (push_to_hub) and reload it via from_hub, and it supports sandboxed execution backends (Modal, E2B, Docker, Blaxel), but none of this evidence explicitly documents deploying the agent to a managed runtime with a callable API endpoint — Spaces are shown as a sharing/hosting mechanism, not an API-serving deployment path. Missing for 10: explicit managed-runtime deployment workflow, documented API endpoint/REST interface for invoking a deployed agent, and any hands-on confirmation of calling a hosted agent via API.
